The 825mm high double door design ensures that space is maximized in any restaurant as it can fit under the counter while still providing plenty of room for your plates. Plus, it's floor standing so you don't have to worry about mounting or cluttering your counterspace with another appliance. With the Parry 9214 Double Door Electric Plate Warmer, you'll be able to keep plates hot without worries!

This plate warmer makes it easy for busy restaurants, buffets, canteens or self-service eateries by allowing them to prepare warm plates ahead of time and store them at optimal temperatures until they're ready for service. For further functionality, the two shelves are easily removed for cleaning.

overview: The Skyline Premium family of Electrolux combination ovens provide a simple to use, robust yet flexible solution to your kitchen. Skyline Premium ovens come packed with a selection of both useful and productivity enhancing features designed to not only make your life easier, but save you time, money & energy in the process.

Unleash the power of the OnE connected platform, with seamless communication between your combi oven, blast chiller and many other OnE connected devices for a truly connected kitchen, allowing for easy HACCP data collection, energy usage, ROI and real time data to effectively control every aspect of the cooking process, ensuring higher yields and lower costs.
Not only will SkyClean leave your oven in a pristine condition, but it also pulls less water and energy in the process.
A game changing hot air distribution system which guarantees uniform heat distribution within the cooking cabinet every time.
An intuitive High resolution full touchscreen interface, simple to learn & easy to use, making cooking easy, with over 30 different languages and can be fully adapted for colour blindness.

Why not add the Electrolux 727729 blast chiller to your order, creating a cook & chill powerhouse combo package, with this combi oven on top of the blast chiller in a footprint of less than 1M wide by 2M tall, combined with a time saving of 40%.
A super-intuitive, high resolution touch screen, which is simple to learn, use and customise, designed to making cooking, easier.
Automatic mode - Includes 9 food families with automatic sensing, the oven optimises the cooking process, according to size, quantity and type of food loaded to achieve the selected cooking result.
Lambda sensor as standard allows for precise real-time measurements and control of the oven chambers humidity.
Skyduo - Both the Skyline combi oven and blast chillers share the same DNA communicating seamlessly with a simple and intuitive mind set, with instant communication between the two units.
Industry leading and industry first 4-star ergonomics certificate, the only combi oven on the market with this certification increasing productivity in your kitchen by up to 25%.

The Electrolux 727729 blast chiller helps unlock this combi ovens full potential, with incredible features such as cook & chill and fast thaw but can also be used for more technical work such as proving, tempering chocolate and sous-vide cooking all whilst saving you up to 40% in cook and chill times, reducing labour and energy costs.
If you can't see an accessory you are looking for on this page, click HERE, to visit the wide selection of accessories we have available for Electrolux Combi Ovens.
features: Experience flawless cleaning every time with the ovens built in automatic SkyClean programs.
With a user selectable cleaning chemical (Solid, liquid or 96% biodegradable enzymatic).
We all want even cooking results irrespective of the oven. Skyline ovens feature OptiFlow.
Reversing fan rotation from 300 to 1500rpm ensures even cooking throughout the whole operation.
101 humidity settings from 0% to 100% with automatic exhaust for crispy finishes.
SkyHub - In one touch, access all your favourite programs all-in-one page.
Cycles + - 11 dedicated programs for specialist cooking, such as regeneration, sous-vide, proving and more.
Up to 1000 storable cooking programs using up to 16 phases per program.
OptiFlow air distribution system - 7 fan speeds, with bi-directional operation, guarantee perfect results.
6-sensor probe for precise measurements of the core temperature of your food.
Triple pane glass door, minimising heat loss, helping reduce your energy bills.
Plan-N-Save helps organise your loads in the most time and energy efficient way possible.
SkyClean - Automatic built-in self-cleaning systems. (Soft, medium, strong, extra-strong & rinse only)
Manual cooking mode - Ideal for the chef who likes to take full control.
Programs mode - Ideal for repetitive menus.
Dry, hot convection cycle (25 °C - 300 °C): ideal for low humidity cooking.
See the food as it was intended with natural light LEDs within the door.
Integrated spray gun for optimum cleaning.
Fully HACCP compliant with a USB port to download programs and settings.
Complete, comprehensive training is available from Electrolux when you purchase this oven.

overview: With the Convotherm Mini easyTouch Black 6.06 Electric 6 Deck Combination Oven you get a full-fledged combi oven on a compact scale. At less than 600mm wide and deep this combi oven is ideal for businesses where space is a premium and the matte black finish makes it a perfect fit for front of house. Not only that but it can replace multiple appliances such as microwaves, contact grills, toasters, and ovens.

You can enjoy time savings of up to 40% compared to traditional cooking systems allowing you to not only offer delicious menu options but also quick service. On top of that you have the amazing user friendliness of the Convotherm Mini whether you have professionally trained chefs or semi-skilled personnel.

The right climate in the cooking chamber is decisive for cooking and baking. Automatic or controlled individually – the Convotherm Maxx ensures that every type of baked good or cooked food is reliably given the right amount of moisture, thanks to an exceptionally sophisticated steam saturation control system. If crispy crusts are also required, precisely metered hot air and moisture removal provide perfect results.

No matter whether fully automatic or manual mode, whether single or mixed loads – many intelligent features enable the Convotherm Maxx to ensure that you maintain a total overview, even with the most complex processes. That means you can work efficiently and with clear focus as well as with less stress.

The best cooking and baking results are not a coincidence but are instead obtained with the help of the special functions the Convotherm Maxx features: Refined sensor technology, exceptionally well-thought-out air flow as well as an intelligent, individually programmable interaction of steam, hot air and time for every food – the Convortherm Maxx ensure optimal quality.

Perfect cleanliness is indispensable in cooking and baking. That’s why the Convotherm Maxx is equipped with a fully automatic and especially simple, reliable, and environmentally friendly cleaning system that is even certified for unattended operation. What’s more, the innovative HygieniCare package provides an extra plus for hygiene in the kitchen.

overview: Wood and gas fired traditional pizza ovens offer the specific aroma and taste of a traditional wood fired pizza oven with the benefit of gas temperature regulation in the baking chamber. The close distance between the fire and the baking chamber give your pizzas a perfect bake. The oven chamber is manufactured from refractory material with a high percentage of aluminium oxide making it extremely strong and wear resistant.
Features a rotating cooking base, giving a more uniformed performance, higher productivity & better working conditions are achieved as pizza peel with a shorter handle is used.
The heavy duty chamber is manufactured using refractory materials with a very high percentage of Aluminium Oxide (A12O3), which makes it extremely strong & wear resistant.
features: Double front doors - Wood chamber & cooking chamber.
Wood combustion chamber is separated from the baking surface & drawer to collect ashes from the burning wood.
Rotation speed can be gradually increased & rotation direction can be reversed.
The baking chamber is dome shaped, allowing even baking & economical use of wood to be achieved.
The wood burns in the chamber of the oven thus giving the pizzas a specific aroma.
The close distance of the burning wood gives each pizza a golden brown colour once cooked.
Heating up of the chamber uses an ecological burner with the use of NATURAL GAS or LPG.
Easily control the temperature of the cooking chamber by a digital controller.
The considerable thickness of insulation helps to achieve maximum economy.
All elements of the oven are placed in a case which allows its mobility.

overview: Wood and gas fired traditional pizza ovens offer the specific aroma and taste of a traditional wood fired pizza oven with the benefit of gas temperature regulation in the baking chamber. The close distance between the fire and the baking chamber give your pizzas a perfect bake. The oven chamber is manufactured from refractory material with a high percentage of aluminium oxide making it extremely strong and wear resistant.
The heavy duty chamber is manufactured using refractory materials with a very high percentage of Aluminium Oxide (A12O3), which makes it extremely strong & wear resistant.
features: Double front doors - Wood chamber & cooking chamber.
Wood combustion chamber is separated from the baking surface & drawer to collect ashes from the burning wood.
The baking chamber is dome shaped, allowing even baking & economical use of wood to be achieved.
The wood burns in the chamber of the oven thus giving the pizzas a specific aroma.
The close distance of the burning wood gives each pizza a golden brown colour once cooked.
Heating up of the chamber uses an ecological burner with the use of NATURAL GAS or LPG.
Easily control the temperature of the cooking chamber by a digital controller.
The considerable thickness of insulation helps to achieve maximum economy.

overview: The Italforni BLL "THE BULL" Tempered Stained Glass Large Electric Pizza Oven is an incredibly powerful and visually stunning centerpiece for any restaurant or premium catering establishment. Engineered from strong Italian steel and fully coated in coloured shock and high temperature resistant tempered glass, THE BULL is sure to make an impact and add wow factor with it's unique and characterful design.

Able to cook up to eight 30cm pizza at a time or hold three baking trays, each BLL pizza oven features a cooking chamber fully lined with refractory brick containing armoured “hy·pe” heating elements and offers a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven's outstanding thermal insulation ensures it's external temperature reaches a maximum of just 30°C while in use. Each oven deck has heavy duty counterbalanced doors with tempered double glazed glass windows and is lit internally by high resistance, high capacity halogen lighting. Operation is simple and easy thanks to the unit's intuitive TOUCH control board and digital display.

THE BULL is modular and fully customisable, with the ability to stack up to three pizza oven decks, a choice of proving unit bases or stands and of course the oven's signature hood. The oven comes in black or red as standard, but can be customised with any RAL colour and even personalised with your own unique designs to complement your restaurant's decor. Site surveys are available to help plan your installation - take a look at a kitchen refit project featuring the Italforni BULL Pizza Oven or call our sales team now to find out more.
Fully customisable - choose from a variety of options, sizes and colours to suit your individual business needs.

overview: The Italforni BLXL "THE BULL" Tempered Stained Glass Extra Large Electric Pizza Oven is an incredibly powerful and visually stunning centerpiece for any restaurant or premium catering establishment. Engineered from strong Italian steel and fully coated in coloured shock and high temperature resistant tempered glass, THE BULL is sure to make an impact and add wow factor with it's unique and characterful design.

Capable of keeping up with demand in the busiest restaurants, the BLXL is the largest pizza oven in the range with over one square meter of cooking space - enough for twelve 30cm pizza, nine 35cm pizza or up to five baking trays. The oven features a cooking chamber fully lined with refractory brick containing armoured “hy·pe” heating elements and offers a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven's outstanding thermal insulation ensures it's external temperature reaches a maximum of just 30°C while in use. Each oven deck has heavy duty counterbalanced doors with tempered double glazed glass windows and is lit internally by high resistance, high capacity halogen lighting. Operation is simple and easy thanks to the unit's intuitive TOUCH control board and digital display.

THE BULL is modular and fully customisable, with the ability to stack up to three pizza oven decks, a choice of proving unit bases or stands and of course the oven's signature hood. The oven comes in black or red as standard, but can be customised with any RAL colour and even personalised with your own unique designs to complement your restaurant's decor. Site surveys are available to help plan your installation - take a look at a kitchen refit project featuring the Italforni BULL Pizza Oven or call our sales team now to find out more.
Fully customisable - choose from a variety of options, sizes and colours to suit your individual business needs.

The ovens spacious 6 x 1/1 GN Capacity, along with it's enormous bank of programmes to choose from give enough power and versatility for up to 180 covers per day.

Along side the window, internal LED lighting provides a clear view of the contents as they cook. overview: The Parry CPC Electric Heated Square Pie Cabinet is an ideal countertop display unit for bakeries and other commercial use where pies and pastries are sold quickly. The three wire racks can hold up to 20 pies each, enough for any medium/large shop to display their favourite pastries. The cabinet comes with sliding doors to the server side making it easy to place and remove foods. With clear visibility of the product and internal light, it provides shops, restaurants and canteens with an effective way to showcase their pies and other savoury pastries, making them more appetizing and encouraging impulse purchases.

The cabinet also has a built-in water reservoir which helps to keep food moist throughout the day, preventing it from drying out or becoming hard, so that customers only get the best quality products every time. In addition, its stainless-steel construction and toughened glass ensures that the cabinet is durable enough for busy commercial environments and can withstand regular use. To help maintain cleanliness in your premises, the exterior of this heated pie cabinet is easy to clean too.

For the ultimate smoke flavoured steaks, meats and other foods, the electric Lifestyle Big Horn Pellet Grill and Smoker is made for the serious home smoker Barbecuer.

Barbecue enthusiasts will rejoice! This innovative smoker is perfect for home-use, allowing you to enjoy delicious smoky barbecue flavours right in your own backyard. With its versatile capabilities, you can easily grill, bake, smoke or roast all your favourite foods.
Designed purposely to use eco-friendly wood pellets for cooking, the Pellet Grill and Smoker offers an electronic temperature control system that helps ensure precise results every time you use it.

Whether you are looking to slow roast or normal roast, the temperature settings can be adjusted to smoke only or can be set as high as 245°C. The pellet feeder speed adjusts to maintain the grill area temperature that is required. There's also an adjustable warming rack so you can keep food warm without overcooking it. The construction of this smoker is heavy duty too — with stainless steel components designed to withstand even the most extreme weather conditions for long lasting durability.

The UK pellet grilling community is growing rapidly and for good reason. Pellet grills are becoming increasingly popular as they offer a unique cooking experience compared to traditional charcoal and gas grills. Unlike traditional smokers, they require no monitoring or maintenance to keep the heat consistent, making them ideal for home-use.

Pellet grills are great for smoking meats, vegetables and even cheeses right in your backyard without having to tend the fire every few minutes. This makes them easy for all types of users - from novice cooks wanting to learn about smoking food at home, to experienced barbecuers looking for new ways to find grilled flavours. Plus, the food cooked on pellet grills will add an intensely smoky flavour like no other with the opportunity of choosing different flavoured wood pellets, such as apple or oak!

overview: The Silverlink 600 range is extensive and includes gas and electric light-medium duty prime cooking to make optimum use of available kitchen space.

The Lincat DF33 Electric Counter-top 9 Litre Single Tank Fryer is one of the most versatile counter-top fryers on the market. The 9L capacity tank means the fryer can cook up to 12kg of chips per hour. As it is thermostatically controlled, you will be provided with accurate cooking temperatures throughout your cooking. For additional safety, this commercial counter-top single fryer also has a fail-safe top temperature cut-out, and, with the front mounted controls, it gives you piece of mind and ensures safe operation.

Having a small form factor, the DF33 sits happily on a counter-top, making it suitable for those cafes, small restaurants, kitchens or shops where space saving is vital and don’t have the capacity for a built in, or free-standing fryer or may still need the space at other times, so provides flexibility on where it is used. The professional counter-top single tank electric fryer is robust, hard working and easy to use. This means it can also withstand the larger busy commercial kitchen environments such as large pubs and restaurants, large hospitals, school canteens, care homes and high volume production kitchens. The counter-top fryer is also handy for those who may need an extra Umph! at peak times, but don’t require it every day.

The DF33 commercial Counter-top single fryer is also easy to clean. The hinged elements provide easy access to the fully molded stainless steel tank, which also means rounded corners, so less change of dirt and grime build up in the tank. The cool zone also collects cooking debris, making it give cleaner cooking results and saves money by prolonging the oil life. The front drain-off taps makes emptying the tanks simple and perfect for those who provide mobile eating or utilizing the fryers at a food exhibition.
As the fryer comes with a Heavy Duty double nickel plated spun wire basket, this ideal kitchen appliance is literally plug & play (Just remember to have your oil ready).
High quality 304 stainless steel tank, fully welded to hobs for added strength & a smooth, easy clean seamless finish.
Thermostatic control with fail-safe top temperature cut out maintains accurate oil temperature & ensures safe operation.

Hinging element with safety cut-out provides easy access to tank for cleaning.

overview: Bolstering The Falcon Dominator Plus range of Induction cooking equipment is the heavy duty E3917i Solid Top Induction range.

With Induction technology becoming ever more popular due to not only it's incredible energy efficiency but also safety and ease of use, the E3917i hits the mark for chefs and owners looking to add a solid top oven to their kitchen. Traditional gas solid tops give the end user unrivalled flexibility due to the concentric gas burners that radiate heat outwards.. Hotter in the middle, cooler at the edges. Simple stuff.

Where the E3917i's induction plates improve on this design is with 5 individually controlled induction plates. Whether you have a large stock pot that happily sits atop 1 zone, or smaller pans and more delicate dishes that require that extra fine tuning, simply straddle the pans over separate zones. Topped with 6mm thick toughened ceramic glass, slide and move your dishes effortlessly - just the same as a gas powered equivalent.

Automatic or controlled individually – the Convotherm Maxx ensures that every type of baked good or cooked food is reliably given the right amount of moisture, thanks to an exceptionally sophisticated steam saturation control system. No matter whether fully automatic or manual mode, whether single or mixed loads – many intelligent features enable the Convotherm Maxx to ensure that you maintain a total overview, even with the most complex processes. That means you can work efficiently and with clear focus as well as with less stress.

The best cooking and baking results are not a coincidence but are instead obtained with the help of the special functions the Convotherm Maxx features: Refined sensor technology, exceptionally well-thought-out air flow as well as an intelligent, individually programmable interaction of steam, hot air and time for every food – the Convortherm Maxx ensure optimal quality.

Perfect cleanliness is indispensable in cooking and baking. That’s why the Convotherm Maxx is equipped with a fully automatic and especially simple, reliable, and environmentally friendly cleaning system that is even certified for unattended operation. What’s more, the innovative HygieniCare package provides an extra plus for hygiene in the kitchen.

Ergonomic vessel dimensions, with a large diameter and shallow depth facilitates stirring and gentle food handling.
Fast working thanks to the high efficient heating technology and well insulation that keeps the heat inside the well.
Ergonomic and user friendly thanks to the high tilting position and pouring lip design which allow to easily fill containers.
Electric heating elements are submerged directly in the water of the jacket, the heat losses are very low and the efficiency of the pan accordingly high.
features: Curved pan base guarantees that the appliance is also suitable to prepare small quantities of food.
Safety thermostat protects against low water level.
Safety valve avoids overpressure of the steam in the jacket.
Constructed to meet the highest hygiene standards using AISI 304 grade stainless steel.
Safe thanks to the high IPX5 water protection and the lower temperature outside the panels.
Deep drawn pan with rounded edges.
Vessel can be tilted beyond 90° to completely empty the contents of the kettle.
Tilting axis located in the middle of the pan keeps the pouring lip high so tall vessels can be filled.

overview: Blue Seal 40 Series Combi Steamers offer amazing versatility and control in the kitchen. Built around a sleek and modern stainless steel chassis with a double-glazed thermo-reflective tempered glass door is housed the ovens spacious oven. the 40 Series suite perfectly whether it be behind a bar, in the kitchen itself or in a front of house setting. Able to cook a wide variety of foods, from doughy products such as pizzas, to meats, seafood and vegetables. The oven itself provides you with both convection and steam cooking, separately if desired or combined together.

The 40 Series are available with both manual and digital controls depending on your needs, and 3 size options to choose from. From 5 trays (30 covers per load) up to 10 trays (80 covers per load). For added peace of mind also, the 40 Series ovens are supplied with a triple action water filter cartridge and filter head.

overview: Italforni's ES12-1 Euro Classic Single Deck Electric Pizza Oven is a high performance, heavy duty modular pizza oven manufactured in Pesaro, Italy. The pizza oven features a large aluminum coated steel cooking chamber with refractory baking floor capable of cooking up to twelve 300mm pizza or holding up to four 600 x 400mm baking trays at a time, making it a versatile addition to busy commercial or professional kitchens, restaurants and takeaways.

Heat is generated by upper and lower armoured stainless steel heating elements delivering a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven is lit internally by high resistance halogen lamps and features a large counter balanced door with tempered glass viewing window. The pizza oven comes fitted with a decorative hood canopy and a choice of mirror stainless steel or rustic style finish, and can be supplied with a range of additional options including open oven stand, hermetic prover compartment, all refractory oven interior and steam injection system.

overview: A first of its kind, the modular Multi Waffle Maker from JM Posner is the perfect solution for sites where fast, reliable, precise waffle making is required. With its unique interchangeable waffle plates, the Multi Waffle Maker gives you the flexibility to cook exactly the type of waffles ordered, without having to use a separate machine for each type - simply swap out the plates. There's eight different plates available, including stick, Belgian and the incredibly popular bubble waffle plates.

With its small footprint, the Multi Waffle Maker gives you plenty of space on your counter to work with. And thanks to digital controls and auto-start, the unit ensures a fast-paced site can quickly turn around waffle after waffle without constant supervision. It's also easy to clean, as the Xylan-coated plates allow you to cook without having to spray oil after each cook - simple.

If your waffles stick to the plates, it could be because of the type of mix you're using. Waffle mixes with low sugar content can be cooked at higher temperatures, while high sugar mixes require a lower temperature to stop the outside caramelising before the inside has cooked. Using a little spray oil can also help release the waffles too.

overview: It’s no surprise that the Enders from Lifestyle Kansas Pro 3 Sik Turbo Gas Barbecue is built for commercial use in mind (it’s literally got PRO in its title) but that doesn’t mean it’s not fantastic for home-use cooking too. The Kansas Pro BBQ comes with a huge range of features which every professional or home chef will want to make the most of this summer.

Let’s start with the Heat Range Burner system architecture. This allows the heat distribution to be optimised throughout the cooking area, ensuring consistent cooking wherever you place the food on the grill. The Turbo zone can reach a “searing” temperature of 400°C in rapid time, which is perfect for getting that delicious crust and sear on your steaks. The switch grid element available in the Enders range means it provides enhanced versatile cooking options such as switching in a pan, poultry cooker, pizza stone or sear grate. You can switch it up to cook your way. And, once you’re all done, the Kansas Pro’s Simple Clean System allows for quick removal of all the components in the combustion chamber so you can clean with ease and be prepared for the next batch of BBQ cooking.

The features of the Kansas Pro don’t end there. From the first time you use it, you’ll see it comes with an integrated piezo ignition, which ensures safe and easy ignition without the use of a battery, which means your BBQ will be up to cooking temperature in no time. It’s Double-walled cooking lid with thermometer and large viewing window means you can check on your food without raising the lid, saving you from unwanted heat lose while roasting, smoking or baking your foods. Any food that is ready to serve can sit hygienically on the stainless-steel warming grate, which is easy to wipe down after serving your customers. The additional side burner makes it ideal for keeping side dishes warm in a pot or pan.

So if you’re looking to do some outdoor cooking at your eatery this summer, then this Enders From Lifestyle Kansas Pro 3 Sik Turbo Gas Barbecue will have you ready to go when the Great British BBQ weather arrives.

overview: Part of the Buffalo 600 Series, the Buffalo FU291 countertop four pot bain marie is an excellent heavy duty solution for keeping food warm. With capacity fir up to four litres in each pot, the Buffalo 600 series bain marie offers a truly impressive holding capacity, giving you plenty of space for large batches of gravy, beans, soup or other similar liquid foods.

Using wet heat warming, the bain marie uses gentle heat to keep food at the perfect serving temperature. This way, not only does it reduce the chance of food drying out, it also prevents the food from burning to the pots. Operation and maintenance couldn't be easier too - with simple dial temperature control, strong stainless steel construction and the front mounted drain tap, it's simple to keep food warm without a fuss.

As part of the Buffalo 600 Series, this bain marie suites perfectly with other items within the range. Not only does this lead to a smooth, clean work line, it also makes the line safer, with less jagged edges. As a countertop unit, this bain marie can also be mounted on a 600 Series base.

overview: The Dominator Plus G3101 has long been the cornerstone of kitchens up and down the country, offering a level of performance, reliability and ease of use that other models strive to match. The new G3101HD delivers the next level of power and performance.

overview: This specific design of heated drawers is fully designed to hold food warm and moist for extended periods of time. Heated drawers are great for holding a variety of breads, vegetables, meat dishes and holding them warm and succulent ready to serve. Each drawer is supplied with three GN 1/3 size 100mm deep containers. The drawer containers are removable and can be replaced with alternative GN ½ or GN1/1 types. The unit is factory set to control the temperature at 85°C and is adjustable between 30 to 120°C. There is a pull out removable water reservoir at the base which provides humidity this helps keep contents moist.

As it's a dry heat soup kettle, the Rowlett doesn't use a water bath, and as such doesn't need filling or topping up - just select a temperature using the digital control panel and the Rowlett soup kettle reliably holds temperature for extended periods. The digital controls are user-friendly and accurate. The Rowlett soup kettle makes service easy. The hinged lid and ladle notch lets you easily access and serve the contents without fuss. And once you're all done, the whole unit is easy to clean.

overview: Stand out from the crowd with AS Terms Mosaic finish dome shaped pizza ovens, let your customers enjoy the pizza and the oven! Traditional gas ovens are a perfect modern alternative to the traditional wood fired ovens as you can regulate the temperature much easier resulting in higher productivity in addition the rotating base means the GR-K series are less labour intensive and you can get the same baking results for each pizza.
Rotating cooking base, giving a more uniformed performance, higher productivity & better working conditions are achieved as pizza peel with a shorter handle is used.
The heavy duty chamber is manufactured using refractory materials with a very high percentage of Aluminium Oxide (A12O3), which makes it extremely strong & wear resistant.
features: Rotation speed can be gradually increased & rotation direction can be reversed.
Heating up of the chamber uses an ecological burner with the use of NATURAL GAS or LPG & a recirculating fan.
The recirculating fan maintains optimum temperature of the oven floor & prevents it from getting cold.
Easily control the temperature by a digital controller.
The power of the burner can be changed by electronic modulator in the range of 5-100%.
The considerable thickness of insulation helps to achieve maximum economy.
The mosaic design is available in a range of colours, please see below colour options.

overview: The Silverlink 600 range is extensive and includes gas and electric light-medium duty prime cooking to make optimum use of available kitchen space.

The Lincat GS9 Silverlink 600 Steel plate Electric Counter-Top Griddle is really versatile and is ideal for the small to medium sized commercial food establishment that requires to save on space. Cafés and small eateries will benefit from the electric counter-top griddle, whether they’re cooking bacon, eggs, burgers or vegetarian alternatives. The two separately controlled heat zones give you further flexibility with your cooking. You can operate either zone independently by the front mounted control for easy and safe use during cooking. The zones also provide a smaller cooking area during quiet periods to be more economical or gives you more versatility when cooking two separate meals simultaneously, for example, cooking your burgers while keeping your veggies at optimum temperature.

This professional counter-top griddle is made with a 12mm thick machined steel plate, which provides even heat distribution and with this commercial kitchen appliance being thermostatically controlled, it gives accurate temperatures during the cooking process for consistent results.

As the Lincat Silverlink 600 Electric Griddle is useable on counter-tops, it means it is suitable for those cafes, small restaurants, kitchens or shops where space saving is vital and don’t have the capacity for a built in or free-standing griddle. The griddle is also ideal for those eateries that like to cook in front of house, allowing the customers to experience the smells and sounds of your cooking while they wait. The professional counter-top single electric griddle is robust, hard working and easy to use. This means it can also withstand the larger busy commercial kitchen environments such as large pubs and restaurants, large hospitals, school canteens, care homes and high volume production kitchens.

When it comes to cleaning, the plate is a flat surface so can easily be scraped and cleaned and as the plate is fully welded into the frame, it also prevent leaks and hygiene standards are improved as places where food and carbon can build up is reduced.

overview: Roband GSA610S/GSA610R Grill Stations - Designed for outlets with a great demand for producing grilled bread products such as paninis, focaccias & sandwiches as well as kebabs, the Grill Station delivers heat quickly & efficiently to the food being grilled. Incorporating clever design features such as elements cast directly into the plates themselves, the machine has a fast heat up time & rapidly grills the food enabling you to quickly serve your customers & produce more servings overall to deliver greater profits for your business. Occasionally you may wish to grill meat & poultry, which could later be used as fillings in your focaccias or paninis & this machine is versatile in its ability to produce a beautifully tender result.
Quality die-cast aluminium cooking plates with cast-in elements for efficient, directional & effective heat transfer.
Easy one-handed loading & unloading of food with the top plate capable of staying partially open at an approximate 45° angle.

A front positioned grease collection box.
Angled control panel for clear visibility of settings.

overview: Henny Penny SmartHold humidified holding cabinets create and maintain ideal conditions for holding a wide variety of hot foods over extended periods of time prior to serving.
The key to longer holding times is precise humidity control. The Henny Penny smarthold cabinet with automatic humidity control lets you select and maintain precise humidity levels.
SmartHold HHC 990 incorporates a proofing mode that uses lower holding temperatures to proof and hold in the same unit—no need for a separate proofing cabinet!

Longer holding times give you the ability to cook in larger quantities during off-peak hours and still serve delicious foods that look and taste like they were freshly prepared. Some items, such as slow-cooked ribs, can even be held overnight, a process that actually improves the flavor and further tenderizes the meat.

Fully insulated cabinet and tight sealing doors contribute to energy efficient operation. Quick-response humidity generation helps maintain precise humidity and food quality. Selfclosing doors provide for more efficient workflow.

overview: The Parry HOT15BM Hot Cupboard with Bain Marie Top is the perfect solution for businesses looking to offer hot food for their customers. It's made of high grade stainless steel which provides durability and makes the unit easy to clean internally and externally. This Servery Hot Cupboard can be used in a variety of commercial settings such as hospitality venues, canteens, restaurants, residential homes or any venue that requires easy transport of hot foods. The unit is 1500mm wide and has a large capacity that can hold up to 450 plates or 90 plated meals at any one time and features castors with two brakes as standard providing safety while serving from the unit. An additional push-handle can be purchased which makes it easy to transport and manoeuvre from room to room. The HOT15BM Hot Cupboard is temperature controlled and can be set up to 80°C, meeting recommended temperatures for food hygiene safety standards.

overview: Henny Penny SmartHold humidified holding cabinets create and maintain ideal conditions for holding a wide variety of hot foods over extended periods of time prior to serving.
The key to longer holding times is precise humidity control. The Henny Penny smarthold cabinet with automatic humidity control lets you select and maintain precise humidity levels.
SmartHold HHC 993 incorporates a proofing mode that uses lower holding temperatures to proof and hold in the same unit—no need for a separate proofing cabinet!

Longer holding times give you the ability to cook in larger quantities during off-peak hours and still serve delicious foods that look and taste like they were freshly prepared. Some items, such as slow-cooked ribs, can even be held overnight, a process that actually improves the flavor and further tenderizes the meat.

Fully insulated cabinet and tight sealing doors contribute to energy efficient operation. Quick-response humidity generation helps maintain precise humidity and food quality. Selfclosing doors provide for more efficient workflow.

Up to 99 programs with up to 6 stages each can be set, or choose from one of the 40 pre-set classic options such as bacon, croissants, roast beef or chocolate brownies - all services are covered.

You can also cook using a choice of time, core probe or "Delta T" functions - this impressive flexibility is ready for your creativity.
Once you're all done, cleaning is simplified too. Simply set the automatic one-touch washing mode to run and the Buffalo HX568 combi oven is left sparkling clean, ready for the next use.

overview: Rational iVario cooking systems ramp up kitchen productivity to the max. With multiple programs & assistants designed to not only make kitchen life easier, but help you reduce cooking times and energy costs while still maintaining the highest standard of cooking. Equipped with a core probe for precise mid-cooking measurements and built with Rational's intuitive control system, pairing your iVario and your iCombi together as a living breathing kitchen. Whether you are deep frying, or preparing bulk meals, the iVario steps up to replace numerous conventional appliances.

Because flexibility within the modern kitchen is key to unleashing full potential, having the ability to cook multiple dishes at once greatly reduces the need for extra pots, pans and utensils. iZoneControl has the power to divide the pan up to 4 ways, giving you the freedom you need. Whether you need to cook different sizes or completely different dishes either simultaneously or on a time delay. Making use of the included core temperature probe effortlessly allows you to produce consistent, delicious results every time.

iVarioBoost is the turbo of the iVario cooking centre, slow heating response time and inconsistent temperature are the bane of any kitchen. With a combination of ceramic heating elements and fast-response, scratch-resistant pan bases, iVarioBoost pushes power to where it's needed, giving you super fast and accurate heat distribution. iVarioBoost's integrated energy management system still consumes far less than convectional cooking methods. Utilising these power reserves allows you to quickly sear meat without a noticeable temperature drop due to cold products being added.
To help ensure lifetime performance & validity of the 2 year warranty for your new Rational, we recommend a site survey & consultation prior to placing an order. Please call for further information.

overview: The Buffalo JB983 mobile bain marie trolley delivers flexible hot holding on the move. A 500W dry-heat system gently brings the food up to serving temperature - all without the need for water to fill or drain, helping teams start service sooner and simplify changeovers. With capacity for two full-size GN1/1 pans, the mobile bain marie suits buffets, banqueting lines, serveries and canteens where reliable holding and quick repositioning keeps queues down.

Built for everyday professional use, the unit features a strong, easy-clean stainless steel body with galvanised wells and user-friendly controls for confident operation. Four sturdy castors (two braked) make it easy to wheel into place and lock securely, whilst a generous undershelf adds convenient storage for lids, utensils and spare pans. Versatile gastronorm compatibility and durable construction make the trolley a dependable choice for efficient, high volume service.

overview: Unlock rapid hot-food service with the powerful and reliable Buffalo high speed oven. Combining tuned impingement, microwave and convection cooking, it delivers professional results up to 10-12 times faster than a conventional oven. Ventless operation as standard removes the need for an extraction hood, so installation is straightforward in compact countertop areas. Despite a modest 2.5kW draw, the generously sized 305x305x305mm (12"x12") cavity handles pizzas, paninis and plated dishes with ease.

An icon-driven programmable touchscreen keeps operation intuitive and consistent, reducing training time for new staff. Menu management is effortless too - transfer up to 1024 cooking profiles via USB for multi-site rollouts and swift seasonal updates. Quiet 52 dBA standby suits front-of-house service, whilst standby consumption below 0.7 kWh helps keep running costs of the Buffalo high speed oven down. Day-to-day care is streamlined by an easy-access front-mounted filter, a stainless steel cavity with rounded corners and built-in diagnostic testing for fuss-free maintenance.

overview: The Buffalo JD457 high speed convection oven is the perfect solution for accelerating output without sacrificing quality. Combining powerful forced convection with high-velocity air impingement, the 2.8kW, 21Ltr capacity rapid-cook oven delivers much faster cooking, delivering piping hot food with crisp finishes - and microwave technology. By using convection and impingement, you can easily cook a 30cm frozen pizza in around 2 minutes and 40 seconds, a panini in 1 minute 40 seconds, and a portion of frozen chips in 8 minutes - much faster than traditional ovens. The high-capacity chamber ensures you can cook more at a time, helping you to keep queues moving in cafés, QSRs and hotel breakfast bars.

Built for busy countertops, the compact footprint features a cool-touch double-glass door and bright internal LED lighting for safe, clear viewing. Rounded interior edges and a residue collection tray speed up cleaning, and the chamber is supplied with a Teflon tray and pizza paddle to get started straight away. A dependable partner for food-to-go areas and convenience operations, delivering high speed and consistent results after service.

overview: Introducing Joe Jr, the Kamado Joe grill designed to take along. Joe Jr lets you take ceramic grill cooking with you to the ballgame, the beach, the cabin or on the camping trip. It’s portable, it’s compact, and you’ll wonder how you did without it!

The Joe Jr. is not truly a portable grill weighs 68 lbs., but it's not beyond portability. Portable or not, it's ideal for smaller spaces and despite its small sizes has all the features of the Classic Joe.The Joe Jr. does all the cooking tasks of the larger units as well. Baking, Roasting, Grilling, and Smoking all come naturally. And maintaining a consistent temperature as high as 750AF or as low as 225AF is easy on your Joe Jr. Grill.

You can maintain low temperatures for up to 12 hours without adding any 100 Natural Lump Charcoal. This can all be achieved because the wellinsulated ceramic body of a Big Joe standalone grill keeps the heat in the grill. The unique circular shape of the vessel also circulates the heat for more uniform and effective cooking.Compare this with gas grills, that let heat escape and cook largely from below.

overview: The LightFry 12E Air fryer brings you the fantastic crisp tasty results of a standard fryer without the need for oil. Using a 2 stage cooking process the LightFry firstly cooks your produce using high temperature steam, doing so speeds up the overall cooking time. Secondly the Lightfry uses hot and more specifically, dry air to further crisp up the food. All this happens inside the fryers unique circular rotating cooking chamber. The combination of steam, hot air and circular motion result in evenly cooked, crispy delicious food. Once finished, simply extract the cooking chamber and rotate to empty your food into a GN pan of your choice.
features: Other than using zero oil to cook, the LightFry provides you with a number of time, money and labour savings.

The same crisp finish as conventional fryers.

overview: The Italforni LSB-1 Narrow Single Deck Heavy Duty Pizza Oven is a powerful modular electric pizza oven capable of cooking up to six 300mm pizza or holding two 600 x 400mm baking trays at a time, making it a versatile addition to commercial kitchens in cafes, pubs or restaurants or for adding pizza products to an existing menu. The oven has a narrow front, making it perfect for kitchens with limited space.

The pizza oven features a deep aluminum coated steel cooking chamber with a high performance refractory baking floor. Heat is generated by upper and lower stainless steel armoured heating elements delivering a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C, and a steam exhaust vent helps remove humidity. The oven has a heavy duty counter balanced door with tempered glass viewing window and is lit internally by high resistance halogen lamps. The pizza oven comes fitted with a decorative hood canopy and a choice of mirror stainless steel or rustic style finish, and can be supplied with a range of options including open oven stand, hermetic prover compartment, all refractory oven interior and steam injection system.

overview: As well as being high-quality, and powerful, the Convotherm Maxx Pro easyTouch 20.10 20 Deck Combi Oven is also energy efficient. A premium combi oven designed for those who won’t compromise on quality and can keep up with the demands of the professional kitchen.

The right climate in the cooking chamber is decisive for cooking and baking. Automatic or controlled individually – the Convotherm Maxx ensures that every type of baked good or cooked food is reliably given the right amount of moisture, thanks to an exceptionally sophisticated steam saturation control system. If crispy crusts are also required, precisely metered hot air and moisture removal provide perfect results.

No matter whether fully automatic or manual mode, whether single or mixed loads – many intelligent features enable the Convotherm Maxx to ensure that you maintain a total overview, even with the most complex processes. That means you can work efficiently and with clear focus as well as with less stress.

The best cooking and baking results are not a coincidence but are instead obtained with the help of the special functions the Convotherm Maxx features: Refined sensor technology, exceptionally well-thought-out air flow as well as an intelligent, individually programmable interaction of steam, hot air and time for every food – the Convortherm Maxx ensure optimal quality.

Perfect cleanliness is indispensable in cooking and baking. That’s why the Convotherm Maxx is equipped with a fully automatic and especially simple, reliable, and environmentally friendly cleaning system that is even certified for unattended operation. What’s more, the innovative HygieniCare package provides an extra plus for hygiene in the kitchen.

overview: Wood and gas fired traditional pizza ovens offer the specific aroma and taste of a traditional wood fired pizza oven with the benefit of gas temperature regulation in the baking chamber. The close distance between the fire and the baking chamber give your pizzas a perfect bake. The oven chamber is manufactured from refractory material with a high percentage of aluminium oxide making it extremely strong and wear resistant.
Features a rotating cooking base, giving a more uniformed performance, higher productivity & better working conditions are achieved as pizza peel with a shorter handle is used.
The heavy duty chamber is manufactured using refractory materials with a very high percentage of Aluminium Oxide (A12O3), which makes it extremely strong & wear resistant.
features: Double front doors - Wood chamber & cooking chamber.
Wood combustion chamber is separated from the baking surface & drawer to collect ashes from the burning wood.
Rotation speed can be gradually increased & rotation direction can be reversed.
The baking chamber is dome shaped, allowing even baking & economical use of wood to be achieved.
The wood burns in the chamber of the oven thus giving the pizzas a specific aroma.
The close distance of the burning wood gives each pizza a golden brown colour once cooked.
Heating up of the chamber uses an ecological burner with the use of NATURAL GAS or LPG.
Easily control the temperature of the cooking chamber by a digital controller.
The considerable thickness of insulation helps to achieve maximum economy.
All elements of the oven are placed in a case which allows its mobility.

overview: The Parry MSB12 Bain Marie Top Mobile Servery is the perfect solution for businesses looking to offer hot food for their customers. It's made of high grade stainless steel which provides durability and makes the unit easy to clean internally and externally. This Servery Hot Cupboard can be used in a variety of commercial settings such as hospitality venues, restaurants, residential homes or any venue that requires easy transport of hot foods. The unit is 1200mm wide and has a large capacity that can hold up to 280 plates or 56 plated meals at any one time and features castors with two brakes as standard providing safety while serving from the unit. The push-handle makes it easy to transport and manoeuvre from room to room.

The MSB12 Hot Cupboard is temperature controlled and can be set up to 80°C, meeting recommended temperatures for food hygiene safety standards. The digital temperature display lets you know the actual temperature inside the cupboard, providing reassurance that your food is being served at the temperature required.

Additionally, it also boasts a 3 x 1/1 GN pan capacity bain marie top at 150mm deep and provides extra versatility as it can be used in dry or wet configuration (please note GN pans shown for illustration only and need to be ordered separately). The mobile servery from Parry with bain marie allows operators to pre-prepare meals in advance - making it ideal for busy environments.

Not only does microwave inverter technology provide even heating throughout the entire cooking process, but it also conserves energy as it provides faster cooking times and operates at the exact voltage required to the cooking chamber to make your food hot. The consistent cooking temperature also makes it ideal for delicate foods such as fish and poultry, which require gentle heating in order to preserve their flavour and texture. The inverter technology also makes defrosting far easier than with traditional microwaves as food can be thawed evenly without risk of cooked edges and a frozen centre.

The Maestrowave MW18Ti Inverter Microwave oven also comes with an LED display so you can easily monitor your cooking progress without having to open the door every few minutes, ensuring your food isn’t overcooked or under cooked.
The MW18Ti Microwave is the perfect solution for any operator needing fast and consistent results, without compromising on quality.

overview: The Lincat Opus 800 OE8210 Electric Clam Griddle can heat your food up to three times quicker than conventional models. This model can be used for a variety of food service operations where your customer satisfaction depends on speed and convenience. Fast food restaurants, street food vendors, sports arenas/venues would benefit from the quick batch cooking that is available from an electric clam griddle.

The griddle is perfect for those who cook the same sized meat products over and over. This is due to the digital timer which can ensure repeatable results, as well as the griddle cooking from above and below. This allows your meat to lock in flavour while reducing shrinkage. The added ribbed plate option can also add an attractive chargrilled mark, making the food look even more delicious and appetising.

Don’t think the clam griddle is only for burger joints. They are suitable to all times of meats of similar size. To ribeye steaks, hamburgers, chicken fillets, seafood fillets, you can also use it for pressed sandwiches, tortillas, quesadillas, burritos, bacon and other breakfast items, and many other options.
If you are already using a flat griddle and find it is always full, then a clam griddle could be a saving grace to your kitchen.
Steaks, burgers, chicken and other meat products are cooked quickly, sealing in juices, locking in flavour and reducing shrinkage.

With 10.8kW of power, an 850mm-wide format and a generous 750 x 600mm cooking area, it provides the capacity needed for high volume grilling while authentic flame-grilled flavour without the need for a gas supply. The OE8416 features real flame-grilled technology, heavy-duty segmented cast iron grids and three independently controlled heat zones, giving chefs precise control over different areas of the cooking surface. The grids create distinctive branding marks, while the enamelled base plate and three-piece stainless-steel splashback help simplify cleaning. Its vaporising technology converts grease and food debris into ash for straightforward sweep-out cleaning. Designed for efficiency as well as performance, Lincat states that the Ignite range uses 41% less energy and is three times faster to clean than its previous Direct Cook Chargrill, while the OE8416 provides 23% more usable cooking space. Built in Britain as part of the Opus 800 range, it is supplied with a grid lifting tool and cleaning rake, with optional accessories including a resting rack, garnish rail and stand.

overview: The Opus 800 range offers a wide choice of gas and electric appliances of high quality, durability & performance.

The Lincat Opus 800 twin tank fryer with pumped filtration is the solution for any commercial kitchen's frying needs! With two independent fryer tanks it provides greater versatility and means you can fry delicious food more accurately at the correct temperatures. The convenient piezo ignition allows for quick lighting and getting the oil to temperature quickly.

When it comes to filtering, the two stage filtration provides extended life to your oil, up to 75%, which means less oil purchases. Plus, the feature of being able to pump hot oil makes this product revolutionary. It means you can filter during service, making it more efficient and in just 5 minutes, your oil is filtered and ready to use again!
The OG8111/OP2 comes with batter plates, baskets, full lids and stainless steel bucket so once it is installed, you’ll have everything you need to get started (except the oil of course).
The Lincat Opus 800 twin tank fryer is stainless steel so easy to clean and, as it comes on castors, it can be manoeuvred easily to get round the back on deep clean days.
The twin fryer is ideal for busier kitchens which require fried foods to be cooked at different temperatures or need the availability of foods to be cooked at different times.
The Lincat Opus 800 tin tank fryer is Ideal for a variety of busy commercial and professional kitchens, whether it's a large pub or a restaurant or smaller takeaway shop.
Integral pumped filtration enables oil to be filtered and the fryer ready for use again in less than 5 minutes
Eliminates the need to lift heavy containers, reducing contact with hot oil and the chances of hazardous spillages
Two oil pumps and two buckets, which is designed to remove cross contamination of the oil from either side of the fryer

Despite its compact design, the Oracle XS delivers exceptional performance by combining three cooking technologies - microwave, fan-assisted convection and impingement - to produce outstanding and consistent cooking results at high speed.

The Oracle XS offers two versatile cooking modes. High Speed Oven mode harnesses all three cooking technologies simultaneously for ultra-fast cooking, while Combi Wave mode allows the operator to choose between microwave, convection, or a combination of both, providing maximum flexibility for a wide variety of menu items.
Adding to its versatility, the Oracle XS is powered by a standard 13A power supply, allowing for simple installation and portability.

Integrated catalyst filter for operation without hood.

overview: The Middleby Marshall PS638E WOW! conveyor oven is ideal for any express location looking to increase their throughput whilst saving time and energy in the process. Where WOW! ovens differ from traditional conveyor ovens is with the use of hot air impingement. This forced hot air cooking process results in both the perfectly melted cheese and a crisp tasty crust. Along side this the Middleby Marshall WOW! oven has safety and comfort in mind. Fully constructed from high grade stainless steel and featuring a Cool Skin safety features - Meaning the exterior of the oven chamber never reaches over 120°F (49°C), ensuring safe operation in a busy takeaway or kitchen along with a more comfortable environment for staff.

With more and more appliances opting for greener solutions in a bid to save both energy and the environment, the WOW! Ovens are no different. The patented energy management system (EMS) works to automatically reduce energy consumption while the oven is not in use. So if you've a lull in service, the oven will in effect sit in a standby low power mode - but as soon as any tray or pizza is placed on the belt, You'll be back up to power and ready to cook in 3 seconds.
features: Middleby Marshall PS638E WOW! Electric Impingement Conveyor Pizza Oven
Impingement PLUS! - Low oven profile with dual air return.
Advanced air delivery system - bakes up to 30% faster than conventional conveyors.
Removable/Cleanable parts (crumb pan, end panels, conveyor belt assembly)
Unique hearth belt provides excellent uniform cooking throughout the base.
Energy Eye" powers down the oven when not in use.

overview: The Middleby Marshall PS640 WOW! conveyor oven is ideal for any express location looking to increase their throughput whilst saving time and energy in the process. Where WOW! ovens differ from traditional conveyor ovens is with the use of hot air impingement. This forced hot air cooking process results in both the perfectly melted cheese and a crisp tasty crust. Along side this the Middleby Marshall WOW! oven has safety and comfort in mind. Fully constructed from high grade stainless steel and featuring a Cool Skin safety features - Meaning the exterior of the oven chamber never reaches over 120°F (49°C), ensuring safe operation in a busy takeaway or kitchen along with a more comfortable environment for staff.

With more and more appliances opting for greener solutions in a bid to save both energy and the environment, the WOW! Ovens are no different. The patented energy management system (EMS) works to automatically reduce energy consumption while the oven is not in use. So if you've a lull in service, the oven will in effect sit in a standby low power mode - but as soon as any tray or pizza is placed on the belt, You'll be back up to power and ready to cook in 3 seconds.

overview: CALDOLUX Cook & Hold is a static oven for Low Temp Cooking (max 120°C) and Hold (max 100°C), with full cycle up to max 10+10 hrs. It is designed to produce better food quality and higher yields than normal convection ovens. The Digital Control panel allows full cycle parameters setting. CALDOLUX use allows maximum return on investment, thanks to greater yield, energy efficiency, reduced labour and intelligent use of space.
With CALDOLUX you can build real cooking and holding stations stacking one or more slow-cooking ovens. This solution allows you to cook at the same

time foods that require different cooking times and temperatures. You will also be able to better manage the workload using one or both ovens. The door opening direction can be easily changed at any time.
The digital panel is designed to handle one complete cooking cycle using all necessary parameters in order to obtain an excellent result.
The core probe recognizes when the cooking ends and lets the oven automatically switch to the holding phase with the previously set temperature
The exhaust slots, both at the front (adjustable) and at the bottom of the chamber (always open), allow to excess humidity to be expelled.

overview: The Sammic ST-33 Conveyor toaster is a professional high-output toaster designed for busy commercial kitchens, hotels, breakfast buffets, restaurants, canteens and catering operations. With a powerful 2.8kW heating system and the ability to produce up to 900 slices of toast per hour, it provides a fast and consistent solution for high volume breakfast and foodservice environments. Featuring a 370mm-wide conveyor belt and adjustable conveyor speed, the ST-33 gives operators control over toasting time and browning levels. He continuous-feed design allows bread to be loaded ad toasted efficiently throughout service, while the stainless-steel heating elements provide reliable performance. Its generous 45mm useful product height allows it to accommodate a range of bread products. Built for professional use, the ST-33 combines a durable stainless-steel construction with a compact countertop footprint of just 470mm wide. At 19.5kg, it provides a stable working platform while remaining practical for installation and repositioning. With its high throughput, adjustable operation and robust construction, the Sammic ST-33 is an ideal choice for establishments that need reliable toast production during busy service periods.

overview: The Roband ST350A Sycloid Toaster, can toast up to 350 slices of bread per hour, with a 'cool touch' exterior and intelligent, energy efficient design.
The ST350A Sycloid toaster is a 13 amp machine producing up to 350 slices per hour. Optimised to handle bread up to 20mm thick,

The innovative & cleverly designed Sycloid motion indexes the toast through the machine, making it possible to achieve outstanding toasting results. It produces even, golden brown colouration across both sides of the toast.

An automatic power-save mode conserves energy during quiet periods by scaling back energy consumption. The intelligent autosense feature detects when a new slice is placed in the machine & automatically prepares the machine to toast the bread. The heat setting in this mode is balanced & optimised for quick recovery to ensure minimal user impact.
Diners can easily see when their toast is ready with the cut-away sides of the warm toast chute which is LED illuminated.
A user-friendly & reliable speed controller allows adjustment of the toasting time to account for different types of bread to be toasted.

Featuring robust stainless steel elements, a brushed stainless steel exterior with safe external touch temperatures, a slide-out crumb tray & a hinged top cover allowing easy access to clean the inside. The toast movement racks are also easily removable & are machine washable.
Patron & staff safety is paramount & the Sycloid toaster has been designed with safe external touch temperatures.

overview: The patented eGrill technology provides a superior electric solution to commercial kitchens worldwide, complementing our existing product base with no compromise.

Like the gas grills, the Synergy eGrill also turns the liquid that comes from the food back into a vapour which helps baste the food as it cooks locking in the moisture and giving you more succulent food.
Like its gas alternative, the eGrill can also significantly reduce your carbon footprint as the grills can produce up to 12 tons less CO2 than a standard electric chargrill.
Whether you choose gas or electric, with a Synergy Grill, there is no fat tray to empty, you simply vacuum out the carbon dust when you have finished using your grill.

The trial sites reported significantly less cleaning of their extraction and baffle system, and the same feedback was received by our Synergy Grill gas customers. Also, you have the benefit of not requiring expensive interlock systems.

overview: The I5 from TurboChef is the ideal solution for establishments that want to rapidly cook food without having to compromise on results and quality. The vertically-recirculated air impingement system from independently-controlled dual motors combined with a top-launched microwave system will ensure products are cooked through with a consistently even finish.

The I5 features an integral recirculating catalytic converter & vent catalyst, as such it does not require a ventilation hood making it perfect for kitchens where space is limited or for front-of-house service in cafes and takeaways.

The Smart Menu system can store up to 200 recipes and software updates can be performed using a USB drive. Additionally the unit has a built-in self-diagnostic to monitor the oven components and the performance of the oven.

Available as either single-phase (1-PH) or three-phase (3-PH) model, both are supplied with flex and either a 3-pin (1-PH) Commando plug or 5-pin (3-PH) Commando plug. If preferred the unit can be hardwired to a mains power source by a qualified electrician.

overview: Italforni's revolutionary Tunnel Stone Electric Conveyor Ovens are the only pizza ovens in the world to utilise Italforni's patented refractory stone fillet conveyor belt design, combining authentic stone baked Italian flavour with energy efficient, high output production.

The TSA Conveyor Pizza Oven contains powerful static heating elements generating a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C, delivering pizza with crisp bases without drying out the toppings. The conveyor belt speed and the temperature of both upper and lower heating elements can be adjusted to suit the product, making the oven versatile enough to cook a range of additional products including focaccia, crostini, chicken wings and more.

Each TSA pizza oven delivers a maximum output of 54 12" pizza per hour with a baking time of just 3 minutes, and can be stacked up to two high for increased output and productivity while retaining the same footprint.
Independently controlled upper and lower heating elements allows a range of products to be cooked, not just pizza.
Automatic energy saving heat control, reduces power by 50% to maintain temperature once the oven is fully heated.

Oven is NOT supplied with stand - If you require a mobile stand , please call through.

INCLUDES 2 YEARS PARTS & 1 YEAR LABOUR WARRANTY.

overview: This USHO Gas Solid Top oven range is the perfect addition to any commercial kitchen. The robust design of the stainless steel exterior and solid plate top ensures that it can withstand continuous use and pressure, making it ideal for busy restaurants and other food businesses.

The unique solid top allows intense, variable heat across the plate to facilitate simmering or boiling without having to adjust the thermostat. The top also comes with a removable bullseye, suitable for use with wok pans. Not only this, but its easy-clean design means that you don't have to spend hours scrubbing away burnt-on food debris - just a quick wipe down with a damp cloth will do!

The oven comes with an automatic flame failure device and provides easy start up with the piezo ignition. It is thermostatically controlled, so you can be sure your food cooks to perfection every time. The enamel lined interior makes it easy to keep clean, and with two racks included and three shelf positions it offers versatile cooking options.

For added convenience, this oven also comes complete with braked castors so you can easily move it at the end of a shift or deep clean days whenever necessary. With all these features combined into one small package you'll never regret investing in an USHO oven for your business.

overview: Barbequing is one of the best ways to cook for large parties during the summer months. The Fir Tree Zenith 4 Gas BBQ offers commercial-grade performance in a compact size that allows for both home and commercial use.

The Zenith 4 Gas Barbecue has a push button ignition making barbeque grilling easier than ever before. With just one push of the button, you'll have your grill heated up and ready to cook in no time. Plus, its foldable design means you can store it away easily when not in use - taking up minimal space! Cleaning is also easy since it takes only five minutes after each use. And, despite its small size, this model has plenty of room on its large grill surface so you can cook enough food for everyone to enjoy!

The Zenith 4 Gas Barbecue Grill has 4 independently controlled burners which means you can adjust each food area for optimised cooking of different types of food. The optional Griddle plate is also Ideal for cooking breakfast foods such as pancakes, sausages, bacon, eggs, hash browns and french toast.
